Please let me know your feedback so I can send the guide for everything.
Thank you very much and have a lovely week ahead.,
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0481653-DC/Si-D/AR-[Multi] Lost Connection CRM:03097000482
additional_info.body:
Hello José, good morning.
I'm sending the whole guide from the beginning, in case you miss something
Buy a CFAST reader - example from Amazon:
Download the FW that I will send in another email (file is too large to send via this email) - be aware that you need to extract the file that I will send.
The file will go from a 2Gb to 90Gb, be sure that you have enough space in the hard drive.
Completely shutdown and turn off the charger:
E
ither by opening the door and click Shutdown or;
Put PLC to stop and press FC12.
Remove the CFAST and insert in the reader which is in turn connected to your PC.
Install this software balena etcher -
https://etcher.balena.io/
Example
While the CFAST is being flash, we can do another task that needs to be performed, with the PLC to stop:
Press FC12 again to turn on the charger, while it's on, use the CompanionTool to flash the routers
Since we are installing a new version, the password needs to be changed and this software does everything on its own (I also send this FW in the other email).
Here you need to change that password: admin01 and insert this one:
iRgIOMpPs8hxoBiiX4lK
Also, please make sure you have your PC in the both networks shown in the guide
192.168.1.X - I normally use the 192.168.1.123
10.20.17.X - Again I normally use the 10.20.17.123
Subnet mask always 255.255.255.0
To add an extra IP address, click on Advanced - Add... - and insert the other IP address
After you finish this, click "Check" again in the Companion Tool and you should have a "Configure" or "Update" button. Click it and wait the timer that specifies in the box below. Usually it says "Wait approximately 2min" or "5min".
After this time, you can click again on "Check" and see if everything is correct, it will say "Everything looks good"
When the flashing is over, press FC12 to turn off again and place the CFAST card back in the PLC.
After it's inserted back, put the PLC to RUN and press FC12 to turn ON the charger.
Charger will boot up, might take a while since it has to make a lot of changes.
Please let me know if it worked.
Regarding your questions:
Did you see the device online? This has only problem with connectivity?
A: I see some logs but there is a problem with our cloud service - reason why we need this version
Has this model RT240 a CFAST card?
A: I'm not sure I understood this question, RUT240 is the router and CFAST is the FW of the PLC, so they are unrelated. So if you are asking if the Router has a CFAST card, answer is no.
Must we update both router devices idem XF3 and XF4?
A: The charger will automatically update the Routers after we insert the CFAST back
Keep me updated, I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0481653-DC/Si-D/AR-[Multi] Lost Connection CRM:03097000482
additional_info.body:
Hello Facundo,
That logo wallpaper is no longer supported from v6.1.3 onwards. Only in v6.0.3 and before it works. From v6.1.3 onwards we only support Screensaver, which is 1920x1080p jpg photo.
These updates v7.0.7 and v8.1.5 were released as a regional update only for certain countries where we have a constraint with the local AWS server, as such, it's not available via the normal OTA.
What I can offer you is to update myself remotely, just like via OTA, but in this case, the chargers must be online. If you would like this option, you can just raise a ticket as normal and mention that L3 needs to install this region-based version remotely.
The USB update/CFAST flash is only needed if you accidentaly update to v7.0.5 from v6, which makes the charger go offline.
Let me know if this is all you needed.
Best regards,
Francisco
